theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_cv_slice_fderiv_time_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ∃ Λ' : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), (∀ x, Λ' 0 x = fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) x ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) x) (Λ' t x) t) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, ‖Λ' t x‖ ≤ B
